decisions.reason: As a multi-model formwork system close to the core offer and important enough to have its own page, it fits the firm's existing engineering and modular knowledge base and is likely to be improved rather than withdrawn.

The automated flow-control product builds on the firm's automation capabilities and in-house R&D, so even with only limited website emphasis the firm is likely to retain it to learn and refine it commercially.

This shuttering magnet block is closely related to the established formwork business, and the firm's absorptive capacity in adjacent components makes continued marketing more likely than an early exit.
Magnetic formwork strips are highly complementary to the firm's existing systems and their dedicated webpage suggests a meaningful market role, reducing the chance of near-term withdrawal.

Because this magnetic formwork component is near the firm's core know-how and was given a standalone presentation, management would likely keep it and build on accumulated customer and technical feedback.

Although this magnetic formwork component had weaker website prominence, it remains closely tied to the firm's established product architecture, so the firm is still more likely to keep it than drop it quickly.
